description: This file defines classes and functions for interfacing with Valgrind's Callgrind tool within the PyTorch benchmarking utilities. It includes classes for representing function call counts, Callgrind statistics, and mechanisms for collecting and processing profiling data, especially via subprocess management and script generation for running under Valgrind.

classes.name: FunctionCount
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a function call count and its associated function name.

classes.name: FunctionCounts
classes.description: Container class for manipulating collections of FunctionCount objects, supporting operations like addition, filtering, and denoising.

classes.name: CallgrindStats
classes.description: Container class for storing Callgrind profiling results, including methods for diffing and standardizing function names.

classes.name: CopyIfCallgrind
classes.description: Wrapper class indicating that a global variable can be serialized/deserialized for use with Callgrind.

classes.name: GlobalsBridge
classes.description: Handles transfer and serialization of globals for subprocess execution under Valgrind.

classes.name: _ValgrindWrapper
classes.description: Internal class managing Valgrind invocation, script generation, and output parsing.

methods.name: unwrap_all
methods.description: Static method to unwrap all globals, replacing CopyIfCallgrind instances with their underlying values.

methods.name: _construct_script
methods.description: Generates a Python script string to run under Valgrind for profiling.
